description: Call a Home Assistant service, e.g. domain light, service turn_on, with an optional target entity and service data.

entity_id.description: Optional target entity_id for the service call, in 'domain.object_id' format (must contain a dot).

service.description: The service name to call within the domain (e.g. 'turn_on').

service_data.description: Optional additional service data object merged into the service call body.

name: call_service
